endorsements.name: Ram Shankar
endorsements.label: Subverting machine learning detections for fun and profit If you are using Machine learning in your feature, it can be attacked! This talk is a primer on Adversarial Machine learning wherein we show how attackers can manipulate machine learning systems to get the result they want you to see. You will learn how to protect yourself and detect such attacks. You don’t need to know about Machine learning to attend this talk – we’ve got you covered.
